key: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
en: This rock is glowing with energy inside...
ja: この　いわの　なかで　エネルギーが　かがやいている……

key: Do you want to mine the rock?
en: Do you want to mine the rock?
ja: いわを　さいくつしますか？

key: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
en: It seems too sturdy to break or move...
ja: 頑丈すぎて、壊すことも動かすこともできないようだ……

key: The rock base may hold more valuables. Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
en: The rock base may hold more valuables. Do you want to open it with Blast Powder?
ja: この岩の土台には、まだ何か価値のあるものが眠っているかもしれない。ばくはつのこなで開けますか?

key: \PN found an Eevee!
en: \PN found an Eevee!
ja: \PNはイーブイを見つけた!

key: "Captain's Log"
en: "Captain's Log"
ja: 「船長日誌」

key: Should you read this?
en: Should you read this?
ja: これを読みますか?

key: Day unknown.
en: Day unknown.
ja: 日付不明。

key: I've been unsuccessful thus far in navigating this hellish cave.
en: I've been unsuccessful thus far in navigating this hellish cave.
ja: この地獄のような洞窟を、これまでのところ抜けることができずにいる。

key: Despite the rails--
en: Despite the rails--
ja: 線路があるにもかかわらず――

key: Despite the stone markings I've tried to leave--
en: Despite the stone markings I've tried to leave--
ja: 残そうとした石の目印があるにもかかわらず――

key: Despite carefully recording my passages through this place--
en: Despite carefully recording my passages through this place--
ja: ここを通った記録を、注意深くつけているにもかかわらず――

key: I'm baffled.
en: I'm baffled.
ja: 困惑している。

key: Utterly and completely...
en: Utterly and completely...
ja: 完全に、まったく……

key: I felt relocating here would be a leap towards progress to finding my way home.
en: I felt relocating here would be a leap towards progress to finding my way home.
ja: ここに移動することが、家路を見つける前進になると思っていた。

key: Instead I feel I've entrenched myself in the prison of this place.
en: Instead I feel I've entrenched myself in the prison of this place.
ja: それどころか、この場所の独房に自らを閉じ込めてしまった気がする。

key: Continue reading?
en: Continue reading?
ja: 続けて読みますか?

key: Progress has once again teased me with her coy seduction.
en: Progress has once again teased me with her coy seduction.
ja: 進展というやつが、また私をはにかんだ誘惑でからかってきた。

key: In my continual stumbling through the labyrinth, I found nestled into the wall, a door imprinted upon the stone in a glowing light.
en: In my continual stumbling through the labyrinth, I found nestled into the wall, a door imprinted upon the stone in a glowing light.
ja: 迷宮をさまよい続ける中、壁に埋め込まれた、光る石に刻まれた扉を見つけた。

key: Beyond its threshold, a world of glittering, static blue and stars.
en: Beyond its threshold, a world of glittering, static blue and stars.
ja: その先には、きらめく静的な青と星々の世界が広がっていた。

key: I do not know what awaits me in the world.
en: I do not know what awaits me in the world.
ja: その世界で何が待っているのか、私にはわからない。

key: I do know that I am weak.
en: I do know that I am weak.
ja: だが、自分が弱っていることだけは、確かにわかる。

key: I am thin, and exhausted-- physically, mentally, emotionally.
en: I am thin, and exhausted-- physically, mentally, emotionally.
ja: 体は痩せ細り、肉体的にも、精神的にも、感情的にも、疲れ果てている。

key: I cannot refuse the chance that this will lead me to safety.
en: I cannot refuse the chance that this will lead me to safety.
ja: これが安全へ導いてくれるかもしれない可能性を、拒むことはできない。

key: But there is no promise in those jilted lands, and I do not expect to return.
en: But there is no promise in those jilted lands, and I do not expect to return.
ja: だが、あの見捨てられた土地に約束などなく、戻れるとは思っていない。

key: If anyone finds this--
en: If anyone finds this--
ja: もし誰かがこれを見つけたら――

key: Please apologize to my little girl, Snow, for me.
en: Please apologize to my little girl, Snow, for me.
ja: どうか、娘のスノーに、私の代わりに謝ってほしい。

key: And her gift-- I would ask someone look after the Pokémon.
en: And her gift-- I would ask someone look after the Pokémon.
ja: そして、あの子へのプレゼント――そのポケモンの世話を、誰かにお願いしたい。

key: I may disappear into this strange dimension, but it need not share my fate.
en: I may disappear into this strange dimension, but it need not share my fate.
ja: 私はこの奇妙な次元に消えるかもしれないが、あの子まで私と同じ運命をたどる必要はない。

key: This is Captain Florence, signing out.
en: This is Captain Florence, signing out.
ja: 船長フローレンスより、以上。

key: Good night.
en: Good night.
ja: おやすみなさい。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 37!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 37!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書37を手に入れた!

key: Info on Psychic Terrain now available!
en: Info on Psychic Terrain now available!
ja: サイコフィールドの情報が見られるようになった!

key: ARC: You're just in time.
en: ARC: You're just in time.
ja: アーク: ちょうどいいタイミングだな。

key: ARC: Hey, \PN.
en: ARC: Hey, \PN.
ja: アーク: よお、\PN。

key: Though I'd join you on this one,
en: Though I'd join you on this one,
ja: オレも今回は一緒に行くつもりだったんだが、

key: Given the nature of who we're dealing with here.
en: Given the nature of who we're dealing with here.
ja: 相手の性質を考えるとな。

key: ???: And you're the Champion.
en: ???: And you're the Champion.
ja: ???: それで、あんたがチャンピオンか。

key: And you've been working with the cops, is that right?
en: And you've been working with the cops, is that right?
ja: それに、警察と組んでるって聞いたが、本当か?

key: Gotta say, I never imagined the likes of me comin' to someone like you.
en: Gotta say, I never imagined the likes of me comin' to someone like you.
ja: 正直、オレみたいな奴があんたのところに来ることになるとはな。

key: ARCLIGHT: Do you mean you're the one who sent in the report?
en: ARCLIGHT: Do you mean you're the one who sent in the report?
ja: アークライト: 報告を送ってきたのは、あんたか?

key: An illegal poacher, asking for city help?
en: An illegal poacher, asking for city help?
ja: 密猟者が、街の助けを求めてるってわけか?

key: ???: And you must be Arclight.
en: ???: And you must be Arclight.
ja: ???: あんたがアークライトか。

key: Name's Breslin.
en: Name's Breslin.
ja: 名前はブレスリン。

key: I'll try to keep this short:
en: I'll try to keep this short:
ja: 手短に済ませるぜ:

key: Me and my gang were commissioned to help acquire a valuable Electric-Type Pokémon.
en: Me and my gang were commissioned to help acquire a valuable Electric-Type Pokémon.
ja: オレとオレのギャングは、貴重なでんきタイプのポケモンを手に入れる手伝いを依頼されたんだ。

key: ARCLIGHT: "Acquire."
en: ARCLIGHT: "Acquire."
ja: アークライト: 「手に入れる」、ね。

key: BRESLIN: Standard work, really.
en: BRESLIN: Standard work, really.
ja: ブレスリン: よくある仕事さ、本当に。

key: But this commissioner...
en: But this commissioner...
ja: でも、この依頼人が……

key: She seems to care very little about what happens to me or my crew.
en: She seems to care very little about what happens to me or my crew.
ja: オレやオレの仲間がどうなろうと、ほとんど気にしてないみたいでな。

key: ARCLIGHT: Surely you're used to taking a few risks, operating outside the law and all.
en: ARCLIGHT: Surely you're used to taking a few risks, operating outside the law and all.
ja: アークライト: 法の外で活動してるんだ、リスクを取るのには慣れてるだろう。

key: BRESLIN: It's not only that.
en: BRESLIN: It's not only that.
ja: ブレスリン: それだけじゃないんだ。

key: She seems a little... unhinged.
en: She seems a little... unhinged.
ja: あの女、ちょっと……頭がおかしいみたいでな。

key: It's got to the point that I don't care what happens to her, or even if we get our cut--
en: It's got to the point that I don't care what happens to her, or even if we get our cut--
ja: あの女がどうなろうと、報酬をもらえなくたって、もうどうでもいいってところまで来てる――

key: We're out.
en: We're out.
ja: オレたちは抜ける。

key: It's too dangerous.
en: It's too dangerous.
ja: あまりにも危険すぎる。

key: And that's where you two come in.
en: And that's where you two come in.
ja: それで、あんたたち二人の出番ってわけだ。

key: I can lead you right to her and my team,
en: I can lead you right to her and my team,
ja: あの女とオレのチームのところまで、案内してやれる。

key: All I ask is a little protection from the long arm of the law.
en: All I ask is a little protection from the long arm of the law.
ja: 頼みたいのは、法の追及から少しだけ守ってもらうことだけだ。

key: What do you say?
en: What do you say?
ja: どうだ?

key: BRESLIN: Good.
en: BRESLIN: Good.
ja: ブレスリン: よし。

key: Let's put a stop to whatever her plans are.
en: Let's put a stop to whatever her plans are.
ja: あの女の計画が何であれ、止めてやろうぜ。

key: ARC: We'll help,
en: ARC: We'll help,
ja: アーク: 手伝うぜ、

key: But I'm not promising any form of legal immunity.
en: But I'm not promising any form of legal immunity.
ja: でも、法的な免責は一切約束しないからな。

key: BRESLIN: I get it.
en: BRESLIN: I get it.
ja: ブレスリン: わかってるさ。

key: Should've known better than to trust a Champion.
en: Should've known better than to trust a Champion.
ja: チャンピオンなんて信用するもんじゃなかったな。

key: Let alone a cop.
en: Let alone a cop.
ja: ましてや警官なんてな。

key: ARC: We can't guarantee you any "protection".
en: ARC: We can't guarantee you any "protection".
ja: アーク: 「保護」なんて保証はできないぜ。

key: You still have to answer for illegal hunting and trading.
en: You still have to answer for illegal hunting and trading.
ja: 違法な捕獲と取引については、ちゃんと責任を取ってもらう。

key: BRESLIN: The law's everything to you, huh?
en: BRESLIN: The law's everything to you, huh?
ja: ブレスリン: あんたにとっちゃ、法律がすべてなんだな?

key: ARC: Not everything.
en: ARC: Not everything.
ja: アーク: 全部じゃないさ。

key: We don't serve the law-- the law serves us.
en: We don't serve the law-- the law serves us.
ja: オレたちは法律に仕えてるんじゃない――法律がオレたちに仕えてるんだ。

key: It's to keep everyone accountable for keeping everyone safe.
en: It's to keep everyone accountable for keeping everyone safe.
ja: 全員の安全を守るために、全員に責任を持たせるためのものだ。

key: So first, we'll make sure you're safe.
en: So first, we'll make sure you're safe.
ja: だからまず、あんたの安全を確保する。

key: Then we'll make sure you're accountable.
en: Then we'll make sure you're accountable.
ja: それから、あんたに責任を取ってもらう。

key: We clear?
en: We clear?
ja: わかったか?

key: BRESLIN: I can tell this is gonna go over great...
en: BRESLIN: I can tell this is gonna go over great...
ja: ブレスリン: こりゃ、うまくいきそうな予感がするぜ……

key: ARC: Complain later.
en: ARC: Complain later.
ja: アーク: 文句は後にしろ。

key: You said your crew was in danger, right?
en: You said your crew was in danger, right?
ja: 仲間が危険な状態だって言ってたよな?

key: BRESLIN: ...One of us has already been waylaid.
en: BRESLIN: ...One of us has already been waylaid.
ja: ブレスリン: ……一人はもう、待ち伏せされてやられた。

key: This way.
en: This way.
ja: こっちだ。

key: ARC: I didn't expect them to be asking for our help...
en: ARC: I didn't expect them to be asking for our help...
ja: アーク: あいつらから助けを求められるとはな……

key: Can't say I care for it,
en: Can't say I care for it,
ja: 気に入ったとは言えないけど、

key: But there's no turning back when someone's in need.
en: But there's no turning back when someone's in need.
ja: 助けを必要としてる奴がいるなら、後戻りはできないぜ。

key: I suspect I'll be counting on you, \PN.
en: I suspect I'll be counting on you, \PN.
ja: \PN、お前を頼りにすることになりそうだな。

key: Skip railcave puzzle?
en: Skip railcave puzzle?
ja: レールケイブのパズルをスキップしますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
